Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need an account to play?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run in your browser, so there is nothing to download or install.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. The Mobile category collects the ones made for touch, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites, light or dark choice and most games' progress stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
Why am I asked about cookies?
Visitors in Europe are asked before non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
Try playing it on a different game page first to see if the problem is with that one game. If it still does not work, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it was.
Where do the games come from?

There are about 12,477 games. Six are made by our studio, Door 404, many are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 50 were sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can have it removed at any time by emailing contact@ilovewebgames.com.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can for our own games. Each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded this way.
